title: Machine-learning tool Manatee prioritises signals for manufacturing esophageal mucosa
summary: A single-cell and spatial multi-omics atlas of human esophageal development was combined with the machine-learning tool Manatee, which prioritised combinations of developmental signals for deriving esophageal basal cells in vitro. Functional validation of the Manatee predictions led to a clinically compatible system for manufacturing human esophageal mucosa. Preprint; the abstract reports no quantitative results.
